oneLine: Global PE funds are eyeing a controlling stake in Gemsons at a 1,200 cr valuation.

sources.title: Global PE Funds eye controlling stake in Gemsons at ₹1,200 cr valuation

synopsis: Gemsons Precision Engineering's promoters are looking to sell a controlling stake ranging from 80% to 100% in a transaction that may value the company between ₹1,000 crore and ₹1,200 crore. Initial feelers for the deal have been sent to private equity firms, including EQT, Carlyle, Blackstone, and ChrysCapital, with the objective of creating a platform for bolt-on acquisitions and expanding capabilities. The Mumbai-based precision engineering company was established in 1982 and is currently led by the second generation of the founding family.
